name: Ningaloo Discovery
summary: Ningaloo Discovery is a family-owned operator in Exmouth that runs whale shark and humpback whale swims on Ningaloo Reef. Tours use a 60ft sailing catamaran or a powerboat, with a spotter plane, guides in the water and free photos of the day. They also run snorkel trips, sunset sails and private charters.
standouts: Advanced Ecotourism certification from Ecotourism Australia
Silver in Adventure Tourism and Bronze in Ecotourism at the 2016 Perth Airport WA Tourism Awards
Selected by the Department of Parks and Wildlife to run the first in-water humpback whale swim tours at Ningaloo
All professional photos of the day included free

trips.title: Ningaloo Whale Shark Swim on a Sailing Catamaran
trips.summary: A full day on Windcheetah, a 60ft sailing catamaran, swimming with whale sharks on Ningaloo Reef during the main season. A spotter plane finds the sharks while guests snorkel the reef, and swimmers go in with a guide in groups of up to 10. The day ends with a sail back to Tantabiddi and a ride in the boom net when conditions allow.
highlights: Maximum 10 swimmers per group and 20 swimmers on board
Spotter plane and guides in the water
No-sighting policy until 31 July: free repeat tour, 2-year repeat voucher or $100 refund per person
All photos from the onboard photographer included free
includes: Bus transfers from Exmouth accommodation to the boat ramp and return
Spotter aircraft
Snorkel equipment and wetsuits of all sizes
Flotation aids on board if required
Morning tea, buffet lunch and afternoon tea (dietary needs catered for)
Sunscreen, water and shade on board
Celebratory glass of sparkling wine
All professional photos of the day, free
All government fees and charges
Boom net tow through the lagoon (weather and time permitting)
A discount on future tours
trips.requirements: Whale shark swimmers must swim confidently and independently in deep water, be comfortable in mask, snorkel and fins, and be able to climb a short ladder back onto a moving boat. No set age limit. Child tickets are 2 to 16 years, 17 and over is adult, under 2 is free. Under-18s must be with a swimming adult; under-12s need an adult in the water with them for whale shark swims. Briefings are in English. Observer tickets are available for non-swimmers.
trips.checkNotes: Prices are only shown inside the Rezdy booking widget, not on the page. 07:45 is the start of accommodation pickups. Finish time is '3 to 4pm approximately' on the page and '4pm' in the FAQ. Season is 'March until the end of July' on the page; the FAQ says sharks are most common March to August. The page's credit card surcharge differs from the FAQ's figure. No-sighting policy details are from the Terms and Conditions and apply only to full-price snorkeller bookings on tours up to 31 July. trips.summary: The same full-day whale shark swim as the catamaran tour, run on Investigator, a 56ft powerboat with a high upper deck for spotting. It starts with a lagoon snorkel to practise, then swims with whale sharks found by the spotter plane, lunch and a second reef snorkel. The site says the powerboat is the slightly cheaper option.

trips.title: Ningaloo Humpback Whale Swim on a Powerboat
trips.summary: A full-day trip on the powerboat Investigator to swim with humpback whales in the Ningaloo Marine Park. A spotter plane finds the whales, the crew reads their behaviour, and swimmers enter with a guide in groups of up to 7. The day includes reef snorkels, lunch and the chance to see manta rays, dolphins and turtles.

trips.title: Murion Islands Snorkel Adventure
trips.summary: A small-group snorkel trip on the fast boat NAIAD to the Muiron Islands, about half an hour away. The islands sit in a marine management reserve with coral gardens, turtles, manta rays and fish, and humpback whales from June to November. Bring your own lunch for the onboard esky.
highlights: Maximum 10 guests
Half-hour ride on the fast boat NAIAD
Coral gardens in the Muiron Islands Marine Management Reserve
Humpback whales June to November
includes: Morning tea
Snorkel gear
bring: Your own lunch for the onboard esky (ready-made rolls or sandwiches recommended)
trips.requirements: Departures depend on minimum numbers and weather.
trips.checkNotes: Prices only in the Rezdy widget. No duration or departure time stated. Departure point is not stated directly; the page says the islands are a short trip from Bundegi. The site spells it both 'Murion' (title, menu) and 'Muiron'. Images are 300x300 thumbnails.

trips.summary: A half-day boat trip from Tantabiddi through the lagoon and along the back of Ningaloo Reef, looking for humpback whales, turtles and manta rays. It includes two reef snorkels with a snorkel guide, and a manta swim if the chance comes up. Bring your own snacks and drinks.

Guests can help with the sails or relax on the trampolines and daybeds, and look for whales in winter. Nibbles and a glass of sparkling wine are included, and guests may bring their own drinks.
